svg.text: Little boat · level 2. The moment-to-moment feel of one move (timings are targets for the implementation).
Finger down on a tray cell.
Piece is picked at once (no long-press).
Piece grows from tray size to board
size in 120 ms and floats ~48 dp
above the finger with a shadow.
Within snap range the matching slot
glows. Nothing jumps yet, so the
Release: the piece glides into the slot
